Business roles focus largely on data governance functions, especially stewardship.
Data Stewards are usually recognized subject matter experts who are assigned accountability for Metadata and data quality
Stewards play different roles, depending on organizational priorities. The initial focus of stewardship is often on defining business terms and valid values
Stewards also define and maintain data quality requirements and business rules for assigned data attributes, help identify and resolve data issues
Stewards may function at the enterprise, business unit, or functional level.
